scope: Step2 training/model pathway only; D2/D3 generation, rainfall split, controller objective, acceptance thresholds, Policy Lock and Final contracts are unchanged.

trigger_evidence.reason: Same-prefix D2 contains strong hydraulic/TFV action signal, while the original absolute trajectory objective fails to preserve same-checkpoint sensitivity/ranking even at H60; H360 recurrence alone is therefore not the primary failure mechanism.

model_pathway.counterfactual_pairing: same event + rainfall group + checkpoint + source kind
model_pathway.preferred_reference: base_action_sha256 when present, otherwise deterministic non-outcome reference

loss.delta_loss: Smooth-L1 on candidate-minus-reference response normalized by pair-specific response scale with a fixed small floor
loss.ranking_loss: signed pairwise softplus using authoritative SWMM candidate-minus-reference TFV
loss.full_horizon_flood_truth: authoritative SWMM node cumulative flooding volume

fixed_training.precision: auto: BF16 on supported CUDA hardware, otherwise FP32; FP16 only by explicit diagnostic override

post_d3_execution_order: wait for complete D3 RUN_SUMMARY without interrupting the current D3 process
build one final D2+D3 Step2 run index with Final excluded
compile V6 counterfactual-group-preserving Train18 and Validation6 shards
run a bounded Train-only action-sensitivity smoke using the fixed amendment
if the smoke shows action collapse or non-finite gradients, fail closed and diagnose; do not tune Validation
fit one Formal Step2 model on Train18 using this fixed amendment
run the unchanged Validation6 Step2, gradient and D2/D3 ranking gates
only after all gates pass may downstream closed-loop/runtime/Policy Lock proceed
